name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Bench Press
steps: Lie on a bench with feet planted and one dumbbell above your shoulder, palm facing forward.
Brace your core and place your free hand on your hip or out to the side to help stabilize your torso.
Lower the dumbbell with control toward the outer side of your chest while keeping your elbow angled roughly 45 degrees from your torso.
Press the dumbbell back above your shoulder, then switch sides.
tips: Keep both shoulder blades and glutes firmly on the bench so your torso does not roll toward the loaded side.
Control the lowering phase and avoid bouncing the dumbbell at the bottom.
